answers.core: There's a perfectly good parser inside of Godot that we don't have access to outside of C++.
answers.workaround: Any other option, like Scony's toolkit, requires re-inventing the wheel and comes with other disadvantages, like performance and ease-of-use, not to mention it would be a very large and involved bit of scripting.
